about: Race fields (the athlete, Nov 16, 2026: "when the race changes, I'd want to consider this like we do the run times where there's a 5K, 10K, half marathon, marathon comparison toggle. You would unlock a new toggle for that metric"; "This could go for ultras as well ... any metric that when you're in stage 2 ... comparing against race-specific events"). The one home of which race fields exist, how a race on coach/races.json is matched to one, and which Fitness tiles each can rank. A race registered, planned or done unlocks its field's toggle on every tile it serves; a finished race keeps it. A race row may name its field ("field": <id>) when it offers several distances; otherwise `sport` must match the race's sport and `match` its distance and name (lower case), first row that fits wins, so longer events come first. `km` is the race distance: toggles list shortest first (the athlete, 6.124.0: "50K should come before 100K"). Norms for a field live in coach/norms.json rows with "compare": <id>; a tile with none on file shows the toggle as Looking for data. Ids follow coach/race_tree.json where the tree has the distance (tri703 is the older id of the tree's 70.3 node).
